verdicts.reason: Reproduced by attribute probes: #waste is a div without role carrying aria-describedby containing waste-hint; no checkbox and no fieldset has aria-describedby in the default state.
verdicts.corrected_description: The waste hint ('Rubble is limited to four bags and mattresses to two') is referenced by aria-describedby on #waste, a plain div with no role, so it is not associated with the checkboxes; no checkbox or fieldset carries the description. verdicts.note: Impact overstated: the limits are in the accessible names of the two limited checkboxes, so screen-reader users do hear them when they reach those options.

verdicts.reason: Reproduced: #vehicle and #waste have no tabindex in the error state; activating the 'Choose the vehicle you are bringing' summary link scrolls to the Vehicle block, but focus goes to body (link no longer focused, expect body focused passed) rather than to a control.
